summary.text: David Silvers is the Democratic candidate for Florida State Senate District 26 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Rick Roth in a race with no incumbent.
A former Democratic member of the Florida House of Representatives and business executive, he did not run for re-election in 2024.

paragraphs.text: David Silvers was born in Miami Beach, Florida, and earned a B.S. and B.A. from the University of Florida in 2001 and a J.D. and M.B.A. from the University of Miami in 2005.
His career experience includes working as a business executive, and he has volunteered with Meals on Wheels and Helping Hands and been affiliated with the Economic Council of Palm Beach County.
Silvers won election to the Florida House of Representatives District 87 in 2016, and was re-elected there in 2018 and 2020.
He won District 89 in 2022 and left office on November 5, 2024, without running for re-election.

His committee assignments over that period included Commerce, Ways and Means, Public Integrity & Elections and the House Budget Committee, and he served as the Democratic ranking member of Commerce in 2021 to 2022.
He advanced from the canceled August 18, 2026 Democratic primary for Senate District 26.
